layman_headline: Fear grips the crypto market — no safe swing trade setups right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful mood with the Fear & Greed Index sitting at 27 and worsening. Almost every altcoin on the watchlist is in a downtrend with bearish chart patterns. Bitcoin dominance is high at 56.3%, which means money is flowing away from smaller coins and toward Bitcoin — a bad environment for altcoin swing trades. Meanwhile, negative news like an $89 million cold-wallet attack and $265 million in Bitcoin ETF outflows are weighing on sentiment.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market is too fearful and trending down for most altcoins. Trying to catch a bounce in this environment is risky. Wait for the Fear & Greed Index to stabilize or turn upward, and for chart patterns to show actual reversal confirmation before committing capital.
expert_reasoning: The best candidates by RSI are BONK (29.35), TRUMP (26.94), and PENGU (28.37) — all deeply oversold. However, my signal credibility data shows RSI has a 71% win rate, which is the strongest signal available. The problem is that every one of these oversold candidates has a strongly bearish chart bias (-1.4 to -1.7), bearish candlestick patterns (Bearish Engulfing on BONK, Evening Star on PENGU and ENA), and price below all major moving averages. RSI oversold in a persistent downtrend often signals momentum continuation, not reversal. BTC dominance at 56.3% further suppresses alt performance. The Fear & Greed at 27 with a worsening trend sits just above my validated rule threshold of 25, where the outlook becomes genuinely ambiguous. Without a confirming catalyst or reversal pattern, entering any of these would be catching a falling knife.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed at 27 and worsening — could drop below 25 triggering further panic selling
Coldcard hack and ETF outflows creating negative sentiment overhang that may worsen
High BTC dominance (56.3%) means alt recovery could lag even if BTC stabilizes
watch_list: Fear & Greed Index — watch for stabilization above 30 or further deterioration below 25
BONK and TRUMP RSI — if they hold oversold territory while forming bullish reversal candles (hammer, morning star), that would be an actionable setup
ADA momentum — up 9.3% in 24h and 12% in 7 days, bucking the market trend; watch if this is a genuine breakout or a trap
market_context: Crypto markets are in a fearful, risk-off environment with BTC down 1.5% on the week, ETF outflows of $265M, and a major cold-wallet hack dominating headlines. High BTC dominance and worsening sentiment make this a poor environment for altcoin swing trades.
context_banner: Market fear is elevated with no confirmed reversal signals — capital preservation takes priority over catching oversold bounces.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 27 with worsening weekly trend (avg 27.9) — market in fear but not yet at extreme levels where contrarian bounces become more likely.
BONK (29.3), TRUMP (26.9), and PENGU (28.4) all oversold, but RSI oversold readings in persistent downtrends without reversal candles typically signal more downside, not buying opportunities.

ADA is the lone outlier with +9.3% in 24h and +12% over 7d on elevated volume ($517M), but without chart analysis data available, the setup cannot be confirmed as a valid entry.
